name: Ferrari World Abu Dhabi Tickets
summary: Visit one of the UAE’s most premium theme park destinations with your Ferrari World Abu Dhabi tickets. Located on Abu Dhabi's Yas Island (an island dedicated to luxury and entertainment), it is the world’s first Ferrari-based theme park. Spread around 86,000 square meters, your Ferrari World tickets price offers access to over 25 unique and thrilling rides and experiences.
